suggestions.title: The self-check's pipeline stub rejects the whole run when a stage throws; the real pipeline turns that item into null
suggestions.failurePath: The stub wraps every item chain in Promise.all, so a throw in either stage rejects the whole gate() call and the case fails with a crash. The real Workflow pipeline drops a throwing item to null and keeps the others. pr-gate.js counts on that: results.filter((r) => r && r.review !== null) at line 307 puts the dimension in missing and keeps go false. No self-check case covers this path. A later edit that drops the `r &&` guard, or that makes stage 2 throw (for example review.findings read on a malformed review), would therefore not be caught as 'go must stay false'. If the stub matched the real semantics (catch per item, return null), the existing null-handling could be pinned by a case.
suggestions.evidence: selfcheck.mjs:34-41 runs `Promise.all(items.map(async (item, idx) => { let r = item; for (const s of stages) r = await s(r, item, idx); return r; }))` with no catch. pr-gate.js:307-308 handles null results. The Workflow reference says: "A stage that throws drops that item to `null` and skips its remaining stages."

suggestions.title: Private ref names have no per-run part, so two overlapping pr-gate runs on the same PR share and delete each other's refs
suggestions.failurePath: readRules names refs refs/pr-gate/${pr}/${tag}/{base,head}, with nothing unique to the run. Spec 28 §7.5 has the session rerun pr-gate after every push. If an earlier run is still going when the rerun starts, run A's correctness agent ends with `git update-ref -d refs/pr-gate/N/correctness/base` while run B's correctness agent is between its fetch and `git diff refs/pr-gate/N/correctness/base...<headSha>`. B's diff then fails on an unknown revision, and B has to refetch or report a failure. This does not produce a wrong go: rev-parse and the headSha checks still reject a moved head. It does cost reviewer time and can produce spurious misses. Adding headSha, or a short prefix of it, to the ref path would separate the runs.
suggestions.evidence: pr-gate.js:151-152: const base = `refs/pr-gate/${pr}/${tag}/base`; const head = `refs/pr-gate/${pr}/${tag}/head`. pr-gate.js:155: "When you are done, delete your refs with git update-ref -d ${base} and git update-ref -d ${head}".

suggestions.title: Evidence reviewer runs pnpm install lifecycle scripts from the PR head, guarded only by a prompt rule
suggestions.failurePath: The evidence dimension tells the agent to run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` at the head and re-run commands quoted in the PR body. The fork check (head.repo.full_name) and 'GitHub is read-only' (pr-gate.js:156, 180, 265) are instructions, not code; the agents carry this session's gh credentials. Suppose a same-repo PR edits the root package.json `prepare` script, which is `husky` on main, or adds a dependency to pnpm-workspace.yaml allowBuilds. The evidence reviewer and both its skeptics then execute that code with session credentials before the user merge that D4 class ③ requires. Spec 28 §7.5 limits pr-gate to PRs this session wrote, so the author and executor share credentials, and the PR's Risk section names the prompt-only guard. Suggest telling the evidence agents to use `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts`, or to skip the install, whenever changedFiles hits **/package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, pnpm-workspace.yaml or **/.npmrc.

suggestions.title: Evidence checkout trusts isolation:'worktree' without checking it before `git checkout --detach`
suggestions.failurePath: The evidence reviewer and its skeptics are told 'You run in your own git worktree ... `git checkout --detach ${headSha}`' (pr-gate.js:180, 265). Separation from the shared clone depends entirely on the runtime honoring `isolation: 'worktree'` (pr-gate.js:179, 248, 271). If the runtime ignores the option, for example a runtime that does not support it or a resumed run without it, the agent detaches HEAD in the shared clone at /home/user/pacman. That is the step-4 violation that CLAUDE.md and docs/pr-review.md treat as a hard rule, and it disturbs any lane working there. Suggest that the prompt make the agent compare `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` with the main worktree in `git worktree list --porcelain` and stop without checking out when they are equal.
suggestions.evidence: pr-gate.js:179 `isolation: 'worktree'`; :180 and :265 tell the agent it may check out; no instruction asks the agent to verify where it runs.
